dependency_loads.purpose: project-owned experiment package reload after adding probes

sensor_angle_output.meaning: Angles to rotate world frame into frame_a via sequence {1,2,3}; unit rad; range -pi <= angle < pi
sensor_angle_output.project_mapping_pattern: Existing closed-loop wrappers commonly map AngleMea[1] -> roll_mea, AngleMea[2] -> pitch_mea, AngleMea[3] -> yaw_mea.

controller_input_expectation.ports: roll_mea, pitch_mea, yaw_mea are scalar double inports at 0.01s sample time.
controller_input_expectation.sign_probe_justification: The roll channel uses a plus sign while pitch uses a minus sign, so direct and negated single-channel sensor mappings were tested.

attitude_feedback_probes.signal_mapping: position feedback from PosMea[1..3]; roll_mea <- sensors1_1.AngleMea[1]; pitch_mea <- zero; yaw_mea/yaw_ref <- planningReference.yaw_ref
attitude_feedback_probes.simulate_error_excerpt: SimulateModel returned False; GetLastErrors had no message text.

attitude_feedback_probes.simulate_error_excerpt: SimulateModel returned False; GetLastErrors had no message text.

attitude_feedback_probes.simulate_error_excerpt: SimulateModel returned False; GetLastErrors had no message text.

attitude_feedback_probes.signal_mapping: position feedback from PosMea[1..3]; roll_mea <- zero; pitch_mea <- -sensors1_1.AngleMea[2] through gain k=-1; yaw_mea/yaw_ref <- planningReference.yaw_ref
attitude_feedback_probes.simulate_error_excerpt: SimulateModel returned False; GetLastErrors had no message text.

first_failure_boundary.boundary: The first newly added single attitude feedback channel, sensors1_1.AngleMea[1] -> controller3_2.roll_mea, is sufficient to produce SimulateModel data=false and empty result context after Iso08 position feedback had passed.
first_failure_boundary.scope: Pitch-only direct feedback independently produces the same failure class; direct roll+pitch together is not required.
first_failure_boundary.sign_or_frame_result: Negating either single channel did not restore GetVarTimes or nonzero aliases, so a simple sign inversion is not sufficient.

claim_boundary: No closed_loop, Factory trace consumption, controller performance, or plant tracking claim.
No official baseline or parameter edits.
B0 PositionCommand contract replay remains smoke-only.
recommended_next_step: Inspect the algebraic/discrete interaction between MultiBody AbsoluteAngles outputs and the Sysblock equation controller inports. A next bounded probe should break the direct connector using sampled/held or RealExpression intermediary angle signals, then test whether feeding a constant or time table angle into roll_mea/pitch_mea preserves result context.
